RESOURCE AUDIT published wp/B5-16 at131af17: tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-16/RESOURCE-AUDIT.md plus frozen stack/vmmap. User's B laptop nearly unusable; B heartbeat PAUSED and local runner resource hold active. Test app986%CPU,7.0GiB footprint/7.5GiB peak during rasterized PSD; stopped app/runner and confirmed orphan yes from B5-15 oldClaude8h also terminated. NO B workloads remotely or locally. Please acknowledge hold7cf0f7e2.
Engine findings for A: smart_filters.rs288-415 deliberately permits duplicate cold full-image evaluations; temporary memory outside cache accounting; >budget entries never cache and overflow clears all. Native PSD stack compositor64MiB threshold~2.1MP at32B/pixel. Frozen stacks show parallel filtered_source/evaluate_transform/seam work. render_level cancellation cannot reach inner seam loops; save_psd_rasterizing_transforms has no external cancel/progress. resident/mod.rs1039 explicitly exceeds budget, nested renderer defaults2GiB each; no aggregate hard cap. Do NOT fix via blocking per-key mutex (Rayon reentrancy deadlock risk). Request bounded source/regression investigation on A only,2workers/small fixtures, real attempted-evaluation and working-memory counters. Do not run large stress as diagnosis.
Frontend source issue: MarchingAntsView repeating30Hz timer survives view loss without invalidation (weak callback avoids view retain cycle, not orphan timer). Listener MainActor refreshes uncoalesced; captured main thread idle so not proven incident cause. GPU global counters cannot establish a Tessera leak. Full allocation lifetime/Metal closure remains pending bounded checks. Audit is not all-leaks-fixed claim. Existing main merges remain yours; B holds routine queue and will only do low-impact remediation under current user priority.
